reason: A driver (often WUDFRd) is logged as failing to load early in boot, before its dependency is ready; it usually loads moments later. Treat as a finding only if a device also reports a problem.
A framework driver such as UsbXhciCompanion is not needed on the controller and reports object-name-not-found. Treat as a finding only if a USB device also reports a problem.
Modern Standby telemetry: input suppression requested as the display turns off. Normal on every sleep.
Modern Standby telemetry: input suppression withdrawn on wake, the pair of Win32k 700. Normal on every wake.
A built-in component lacks a COM launch or activation permission it does not need. Microsoft documents this event as safe to ignore.
